svg.text: Figure 1. Burial does not distinguish the annotated TMCO6 segments from real transmembrane helices
AlphaFold model AF-Q96DC7-F1; shaded bands mark UniProt TRANSMEM 338-358 and 386-406 (ECO:0000255)
A Burial: Calpha neighbours within 10 A (9-residue mean)
B Fraction of charged residues, K/R/D/E (9-residue mean)
Burial is uninformative here: the transmembrane helices of AQP1, GLUT1 and ABCG2 are equally or more
buried in their own models. The reassignment of TMCO6 rests on the fold match, not on this measure.
